verdict.summary: A token trades, but the core of what the holder has cannot be said because nobody who could say it is identified: every T, A, holds, backed and audited statement has an unnamed signer. The only identified party, ORO Labs, publishes a disclaimer, which is what v3 can record. The difficulty is evidence, not vocabulary, though a lent predicate would be needed for the stGOLD leasing the older catalogue describes.
